name: GitNexus
description: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine - GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph creator that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (Github, Gitlab, Azure, Local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built in Graph RAG Agent. Perfect for code exploration
one_liner: Drop in any codebase and get an interactive map of how all the files and functions connect, plus a chatbot that answers questions about it — all running in your browser, no server needed.
buyer: A contractor or new engineering hire who needs to understand an unfamiliar, undocumented codebase fast.
business_use_cases: A contractor onboarding onto a client's messy legacy codebase generates a knowledge graph instead of spending a week reading code.
An engineering manager uses it to spot risky, tangled modules before a big refactor.
A due-diligence firm evaluating a startup's codebase for acquisition gets an instant architecture overview.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'codebase audit report' service for startups going through acquisition due diligence.
Sell a hosted team version with saved graphs and collaboration for engineering orgs.

steal_this: Offer $200 'understand your legacy codebase in a day' audits to startups this weekend, using this to generate the graph and walk them through it.
